blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with impressive perception and understanding capabilities will enable a range of downstream applications. However, their substantial computational and memory requirements hinder the real-world implementation, particularly for resource-constrained edge devices. Quantization has emerged as an effective solution for deploying large models. While post-training quantization (PTQ) successfully retains the performance at moderate bit-width (e.g., W8A8), it suffers from severe performance degradation under low-bit quantization (e.g., W4A8), especially for small-scale models that are more suitable for edge deployment. In this paper, we propose ProQuant, a novel weight-activation quantization-aware training (QAT) framework tailored for low-bit MLLMs. First, to align the limited finetuning dataset distribution with the pretrained dataset distribution, we propose a self-relabeling (SRL) scheme to resample the responses of the open-source multimodal dataset. Second, we are the first to take a decoupled view of multi-modal (MM) understanding and language modeling abilities. We propose a progressive block activation (PBA) mechanism to prioritize the MM understanding recovery. We also introduce a vision-sensitive factor $\vecτ$ that effectively identifies the MM-critical layers. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks, covering models with 2B-8B parameters, show that ProQuant significantly outperforms existing methods. For example, our W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct improves average accuracy by impressively 6.6% and achieves performance comparable to full precision counterparts with only approximately 1% performance drop. Code is available at https://github.com/yufeixue-ai/ProQuant/.
blocks.zh: 具有令人印象深刻的感知和理解能力的多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)将使得一系列下游应用成为可能. 然而,它们的大量计算和内存要求阻碍了现实世界的实施,特别是对受资源制约的边缘设备。 量子化已成为部署大型模型的有效解决方案. 虽然训练后量子化(PTQ)成功保留了中等比特宽的性能(如W8A8),但在低比特量子化(如W4A8)下,其性能严重退化,尤其是对于更适合边缘部署的小型模型而言. 在本文中,我们提出ProQuant,一个为低位的MLLMs量身定制的新型重量-激活量子-意识培训(QAT)框架. 首先,为了使有限的微调数据集分布与预先训练的数据集分布保持一致,我们提议一个自我重贴标签(SRL)方案,以重新模拟开源多式联运数据集的响应. 第二,我们首先对多模式理解和语言建模能力采取脱钩的观点。 我们建议建立一个渐进区块激活机制,以优先考虑MM理解的恢复。 我们还引入了一个对视觉敏感的系数$\vec\$,有效识别MM关键层. 跨越各种基准的广泛实验,涵盖有2B-8B参数的模型,表明ProQuant大大超过现有方法. 例如,我们的W4A8 Quen3-VL-2B-指令将平均精度提高了6.6%,并实现了与完全精度对应的性能可比较,性能下降率只有1%左右. 代码见https://github.com/yufeixue-ai/ProQuant/。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Extending large language models (LLMs) beyond text to additional modalities [ Bai et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2024a ; Xiaomi, 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Team, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ] has achieved remarkable successes and enabled a wide range of applications, including chatbots [ Bai et al., 2025a ] , autonomous driving [ Tian et al., 2024 ] , and AR/VR glasses [ Chen et al., 2024 ] . However, the large memory footprint and substantial computational overhead [ Huang et al., 2026 ; Lv et al., 2025 ] of multi-modal LLMs (MLLMs) present major obstacles to deployment in resource-constrained environments, especially on edge devices [ An et al., 2026 ; Shao and Li, 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ] . Quantization [ Gholami et al., 2022 ] alleviates this issue by reducing the precision of both weights and activations, thereby accelerating memory access and computation. Post-training quantization (PTQ) [ Xiao et al., 2023 ; Ashkboos et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Huang et al., 2024b ; Huang et al., 2025b ; Gong et al., 2024 ; Gong et al., 2025 ] typically delivers near-lossless performance at moderate precision (e.g., W8A8), yet its accuracy degrades markedly when pushed to lower-bit settings (e.g., W4A4/W4A8). Additionally, small-scale models (2B/4B), which are more practical for edge deployment, typically suffer more pronounced performance degradation after quantization [ Chen et al., 2025b ] .
blocks.zh: 将大语言模型(LLMs)扩展到文本以外的其他模式[Bai等,2025年a;Li等,2024年a;Xiaomi,2025年;Zhu等,2025年;Wu等,2024年;Team,2026年;Li等,2026年c]已经取得了显著成功并使得各种应用得以实现,包括聊天机器人[Bai等,2025年a],自主驾驶[天等,2024年],以及AR/VR眼镜[ 陈等,2024]. 然而,多式联运有限责任公司(LLMs)的庞大内存足迹和大量的计算间接费用[Huang等,2026;Lv等,2025]对在资源受限的环境下,特别是在边缘设备上的部署构成重大障碍[。 An等,2026;Shao and Li,2025;Yuan等,2025)]. 量子化[Gholami等,2022]通过降低重量和活化的精度来缓解这一问题,从而加快了内存的存取和计算. 训练后量化(PTQ) [Xiao等,2023;Ashkboos等,2024;Liu等,2024b;Huang等,2024b;Huang等,2025b;Gong等,2024;Gong等,2025] 通常以中度精确度(如:W8A8)提供近乎无损的性能,但其精度被推向下位设置时会明显下降(如:W4A4/W4A8)。 此外,小型模型(2B/4B)对于边缘部署更为实用,通常在被分解后,性能退化更明显[Chen等人,2025b]。

blocks.en: In contrast, quantization-aware training (QAT) that incorporates quantization during training has emerged as a promising solution to recover the model performance under low-bit quantization settings [ Liu et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Huang et al., 2025a ] . The QAT solutions for LLM primarily target the training data corpus [ Liu et al., 2023 ] , training efficiency [ Chen et al., 2025a ] , or distillation paradigm [ Du et al., 2024 ] . In the context of MLLM QAT, additional challenges arise. First, preserving the zero-shot generalization of compressed models hinges on high-quality fine-tuning data that are sufficiently broad and well-aligned with the original pre-training distribution. However, open-source datasets are often domain-narrow or distribution-shifted [ Liu et al., 2023 ] , and multi-modal (MM) data are far more difficult to collect than text-only data [ Guo et al., 2025 ] . Second, quantization degrades both MM understanding and language modeling capabilities. A natural question is whether these two capabilities should be recovered jointly, or whether one should be prioritized during training.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,在培训期间纳入量化的量化-认识培训(QAT)已成为在低位量化环境下恢复模型性能的一种有希望的解决办法[刘等,2023;杜等,2024;陈等,2025b;黄等,2025a]. LLM的QAT解决方案主要针对培训数据库[刘等,2023],培训效率[陈等,2025a],或蒸馏范式[杜等,2024]. 在MLLM QAT方面,出现了更多的挑战。 首先,保持压缩模型的零射通化取决于高质量的微调数据,这些数据足够广泛,并与最初的训练前分布非常吻合. 然而,开源数据集往往被域-窄或分布-转移[刘等,2023],而多式(MM)数据比只用文本的数据更难收集[郭等,2025]. 第二,量化既会降低MM理解能力,也会降低语言建模能力. 一个自然的问题是,这两项能力是否应当共同恢复,还是在培训期间是否应当优先考虑。

blocks.zh: 图1:Naive QAT V.s. ProQuant(英语:ProQuant).

blocks.en: Considering the challenges discussed above, we propose ProQuant , a novel QAT framework tailored to small-scale MLLMs, as illustrated in Figure 1 . First, we propose a self-relabeling (SRL) scheme that re-annotates the training set to better align the fine-tuning data distribution with the model distribution. Second, we introduce a progressive block activation (PBA) mechanism that prioritizes recovering the MM understanding ability by first enabling quantization for vision-sensitive layers while keeping the remaining blocks in full precision during the forward pass. As training progresses, we gradually activate quantization for increasingly text-sensitive layers, thereby restoring language modeling capability. The core contributions are summarized as follows: ⊳ \triangleright We propose ProQuant , a dedicated QAT framework for MLLMs. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first weight-activation QAT framework for MLLMs, enabling effective low-bit (e.g., W4A8/W4A4) quantization. ⊳ \triangleright To address the scarcity of high-quality MM data, we introduce the SRL scheme, which re-annotates the fine-tuning data to better match the model distribution, thereby reducing data mismatch and improving post-quantization generalization. ⊳ \triangleright We take a disentangled view of MM understanding and language modeling capabilities during quantization. Particularly, we propose the PBA mechanism to prioritize recovering MM understanding first, and then gradually restore language modeling ability, instead of jointly optimizing both from the outset. ⊳ \triangleright Extensive experiments show that ProQuant achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across various models and quantization settings. Notably, ProQuant attains near-lossless compression ( ∼ \sim 1% performance drop) under W4A8 quantization and substantially outperforms baselines under W4A4, where PTQ methods often collapse.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Post-training quantization for (M)LLMs.
blocks.zh: 2.1 (M)LLMs的训练后量化。

blocks.en: PTQ has become a widely adopted technique for compressing and accelerating large models. In the context of LLMs, SmoothQuant-style methods [ Xiao et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2023 ; Shao et al., 2023 ] mitigate activation outliers in transformer blocks via smoothing-based transformations. More recently, incoherence-processing-based approaches [ Ashkboos et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Hu et al., 2025 ] reshape weight distributions into more quantization-friendly ones, albeit at the cost of introducing online activation rotations. An orthogonal line of work, namely Hessian-informed techniques [ Frantar et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2025b ] , performs iterative weight quantization with closed-form updates. However, PTQ for VLMs is considerably more challenging due to heterogeneous features and mismatched distributions between text and vision modalities. Recent efforts such as MBQ [ Li et al., 2025a ] and VLMQ [ Xue et al., 2025 ] attribute performance degradation to modality discrepancy and apply asymmetric treatments to vision and text tokens during quantization. MQuant [ Yu et al., 2025 ] further extends rotation-based quantization by introducing modality-specific static activation quantization and attention-invariant flexible switching to better handle outliers.
blocks.zh: PTQ已经成为被广泛采纳的压缩和加速大型模型的技术. 在LLMs中,平滑量子风格方法[Xiao等,2023;Lin等,2023;Shao等,2023]通过平滑基变换来缓解变压器块中的活化外延. 最近,基于不一致处理的办法[Ashkboos等人, ; 2024; Liu等, 2024b; Hu等, 2025)]将重量分布重塑为更便于量化的分布,尽管代价是引入了在线活化旋转. 一种正弦工作线,即黑森知情技术[Frantar等,2022;Li等,2025b],以闭式更新方式进行迭接量子化。 然而,由于文字和视觉模式的特征不一和分布不匹配,VLMs的PTQ更具挑战性。 最近的努力,如MBQ[Li等,2025年a]和VLMQ[Xue等,2025年]将性能退化归因于模式差异,并在量化过程中对视觉和文字符号应用不对称的处理. MQuant [Yu等,2025]通过引入特定模式的静态活化和注意力-变化性弹性切换来更好的处理输出器,进一步扩大了以旋转为主的量化.

blocks.en: 2.2 Quantization-aware training for (M)LLMs.
blocks.zh: 2.2 为(M)LLMs提供量化-意识培训。

blocks.en: QAT can further improve quantized models’ accuracy beyond PTQ, particularly under low-bit settings. LLM-QAT [ Liu et al., 2023 ] pioneers the QAT paradigm for language transformers. Efficient-QAT [ Chen et al., 2025a ] improves training efficiency via block-wise initialization of quantization parameters. BitDistiller [ Du et al., 2024 ] and SPEED-Q [ Guo et al., 2025 ] investigate knowledge distillation within the quantization context. Other learning-based works [ Wang et al., 2024a ; Xie et al., 2024 ] enhance quantized performance by exploiting cross-layer dependencies and refining the data corpus, respectively. However, except for LLM-QAT, the above methods primarily target weight-only quantization. To the best of our knowledge, no previous work has systematically explored weight-activation quantization for MLLMs. See Appendix A.1 for more details.
blocks.zh: QAT可以进一步提高量化模型的精度,超越了PTQ,特别是在低位设置下. LLM-QAT [刘等,2023]为语言变换器开创了QAT范式. 高效-QAT [Chen等,2025a]通过以区块方式初始化量化参数来提高培训效率。 BitDistiller [Du等, 2024]和SPEED-Q [Guo等, 2025] 调查量化背景下的知识分馏. 其他以学习为主的作品[Wang等,2024a;Xie等,2024]]通过分别利用跨层次的依存关系和精炼数据体能来提升量化性能. 然而,除LLM-QAT外,上述方法主要针对只重量化. 据我们所知,以前的工作没有系统地探索过MLLMs的重量活性量化。 详见附录A.1。

blocks.en: In this section, we present ProQuant , a dedicated QAT framework for MLLMs that improves both the fine-tuning data distribution and the training pipeline. Specifically, 1) to obtain high-quality fine-tuning data that are closely aligned with the pre-training distribution, we discard the original labels in open-source MM datasets and resample responses from the model to quantize. Then, 2) We adopt a disentangled view of MM understanding and language modeling in MLLMs, and prioritize recovering MM understanding first via the proposed PBA mechanism. The vision-sensitive modules in the LLM backbone are identified using our proposed factor τ → \vec{\tau} .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了ProQuant,这是一个针对MLLM的专用QAT框架,它改进了数据分配的微调和培训管道。 具体地说,1)为了获得与训练前分布紧密相通的高质量微调数据,我们放弃了开源的MM数据集中原有的标签,从模型中重新取出对应的分数. 接下来 2) 我们对MLLMs中的MM理解和语言建模采取分散的观点,并优先通过拟议的PBA机制恢复MM的理解. LLM主干线中的视觉敏感模块是用我们提议的系数\\\ vec\tau}确定的。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Augmentation via Self-Relabeling
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 通过自我再标签进行数据增强

blocks.en: SRL scheme. To align the distribution of the limited fine-tuning data with the pretrained data distribution, we resample responses for open-source MM datasets, which we refer to as the SRL scheme. Specifically, we re-generate responses with the target model using default sampling parameters until reaching either the [EOS] token or the maximum generation length. In Figure 2 (left), We present responses of GPT-4 [ Bubeck et al., 2023 ] and Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct triggered by prompts from the COCO caption dataset [ Liu et al., 2024a ] . The two sets of responses exhibit distinct styles, suggesting a distribution gap between the original labels and the target-model outputs. In particular, GPT-style [ Bubeck et al., 2023 ] captions tend to be more literal and position-aware (e.g., “ in the center of the table ”), whereas the Qwen-series MLLMs [ Bai et al., 2025a ] produce captions that are more holistic, semantically enriched, and interpretive (e.g., “ creatively decorated donuts ”). Such a stylistic mismatch can introduce inconsistent supervision during training, and the resampled distribution better aligns with the pretrained data distribution of models to quantize.
blocks.zh: SRL计划. 为了将有限微调数据的分布与预先训练出的数据分布相配合,我们重新对开源MM数据集的响应,我们称之为SRL计划. 具体来说,我们利用默认的采样参数,用目标模型重新生成反应,直到达到[EOS]令牌或最大生成长度. 在图2(左)中,我们提出GPT-4[Bubeck等人,2023年]和由COCO标题数据集的提示所触发的Qune3-VL-2B-指示的答复[刘等人,2024a]。 这两套答复表现出不同的风格,表明原始标签与目标模型产出之间的分配差距。 特别是,GPT风格[Bubeck等,2023年]的字幕往往比较有文字和位置意识(例如“在表中央”),而Quen系列的MLLMs[Bai等,2025年a]则产生更全面、更精致和更具解释性的字幕(例如“创造性地装饰甜甜圈”)。 这种结构错配在训练期间会引入不一致的监管,被重印的分布会更好地与模型的预修数据分布相配合来进行定量.

blocks.en: Effectiveness of SRL. We further evaluate quantized models trained on datasets produced by different labelers in Section 4.3 . The results show that self-generated labels consistently achieve the best performance, outperforming both a stronger closed-source labeler and a homogeneous larger labeler. Appendix D.4 further compares target-model likelihood, vocabulary coverage, response length, formatting, and semantic similarity on paired cases. These analyses support target-distribution alignment beyond a single stylistic factor and characterize the limits of cross-model label transfer.
blocks.zh: 性健康和生殖健康的有效性。 我们进一步评价第4.3节中不同标签者生产的数据集培训的量化模型。 结果显示,自制的标签一直能达到最佳的性能,表现优于更强的闭源标签和同质的大标签. 附录D.4进一步比较了成对案件中的目标模型可能性,词汇覆盖范围,响应长度,格式化,语义相似等. 这些分析支持目标分布配比超越了单一的分型因子,并定性了跨型号标签传输的极限.

blocks.en:
Motivation. Quantization degrades both MM understanding and language modeling in MLLMs, making QAT substantially more challenging than for text-only LLMs [ Liu et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025a ] . Naive QAT attempts to recover these two capabilities jointly, yet yields suboptimal results (see Section 4 for details).
We therefore decouple MM understanding and language modeling during training via the proposed PBA mechanism.
As illustrated in Figure 3 , initial evaluations of the round-to-nearest baseline (0-th iteration) reveal a stark performance disparity: while the quantized backbone retains a non-trivial linguistic prior (47.33% accuracy on HellaSwag), its MM understanding collapses entirely (0% on AI2D).
This phenomenon suggests that cross-modal alignment is significantly more vulnerable to quantization noise than the model’s intrinsic generative inertia.
Since MM understanding is the prerequisite anchor for grounded reasoning, we propose to prioritize the restoration of the MM understanding path before progressively refining the more text-sensitive modules.

Effectiveness of τ \tau . We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed vision-sensitivity factor τ → \vec{\tau} from two perspectives: convergence behavior and checkpoint performance. We first compare the loss trajectories of the first 300 training steps under TSB-prioritized and VSB-prioritized schedules in Figure 4 .
The VSB-prioritized schedule converges faster, indicating that prioritizing multimodal understanding is beneficial for optimization.
We further report checkpoint performance from 0K to 4K iterations in Figure 3 .
As shown in Figure 3 , the VSB-prioritized schedule restores language modeling more slowly at early stages than the TSB-prioritized one, but surpasses it by 4K iterations.
Meanwhile, in Figure 3 , the VSB-prioritized schedule recovers MM understanding substantially faster and outperforms the TSB-prioritized schedule at nearly all checkpoints. Overall, τ → \vec{\tau} -guided PBA effectively prioritizes the recovery of MM understanding over language modeling, leading to faster early-stage convergence and better final performance.

Effectiveness of PBA. We further validate the effectiveness of PBA by comparing the full training trajectories in Figure 6 against a naive QAT baseline.

blocks.en: 4.2 Performance Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 业绩分析

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Performance under W4A8 & W4A4 quantization.
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 W4A8和W4A4量化下的性能。

blocks.en: We report the performance of quantized models on a diverse set of MM benchmarks in Table 1 . Overall, ProQuant consistently outperforms both PTQ and QAT baselines across all model backbones and quantization settings, with the advantage becoming especially significant in the more aggressive W4A4 regime.
blocks.zh: 我们按表1中一套不同的MM基准报告量化模型的业绩。 总体而言,ProQuant在所有示范骨干和量化设置中,PTQ和QAT基线的业绩都一直高于后者,其优势在更为积极的W4A4制度中变得尤为重要。

blocks.en: Under W4A8 quantization, ProQuant preserves the performance of the full-precision models remarkably well. Across all three backbones, the average accuracy of ProQuant remains within approximately one point of the BF16 counterparts (i.e., around ∼ 1 % \sim 1\% absolute degradation), indicating near-lossless quantization in this setting. In contrast, existing PTQ and QAT baselines exhibit noticeably larger drops on multiple benchmarks, even when their performance is competitive on a subset of metrics.
blocks.zh: 在W4A8量子化下,ProQuant保存了全精度模型的性能出众. 在所有三根主干线上,ProQuant的平均精度保持在BF16对应物的大约一分之内(即大约为 1%\sim 1+%),表明在此情况下几乎无损失地被量化。 相比之下,现有的PTQ和QAT基线在多个基准上明显出现较大下降,即使其性能在一组指标上具有竞争力。

blocks.en: The performance gap becomes much larger under W4A4 quantization. In this regime, PTQ baselines (e.g., MBQ and MQuant) largely collapse, with near-zero or extremely low scores on multiple benchmarks, indicating that they fail to maintain usable multi-modal reasoning and perception abilities at 4-bit activation quantization. The LLM-QAT baseline is substantially more robust than PTQ, but still suffers severe degradation; in particular, it can only maintain reasonable performance when down_proj activations are kept at 8-bit. Even with this relaxation, its performance remains far below ProQuant in most cases.
blocks.zh: 在W4A4量化下,性能差距会变大得多. 在这个制度中,PTQ基线(如MBQ和MQuant)基本崩溃了,在多个基准上得分接近零或极低,这表明在4位活化量化时,它们无法保持可用的多模式推理和感知能力. LLM-QAT基线比PTQ强得多,但仍然会严重退化;特别是,当下-proj活化被保持在8位时,它才能保持合理的性能. 即使这种放松,在大多数情况下,其业绩仍然远远低于ProQuant。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Performance under W8A8 quantization.
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 W8A8量化下的业绩。

blocks.en: Table 2 : W8A8 quantization results on three model backbones. Values in red denote the corresponding full-precision (BF16) performance.
blocks.zh: 表2:W8A8对3个型号骨干进行量化的结果. 红色值表示相应的全精度(BF16)性能.

blocks.en: Under the relatively mild W8A8 setting, both PTQ approaches and ProQuant achieve performance comparable to BF16 across all three backbones, indicating that strong PTQ methods are already sufficient in this regime and that the extra training cost of QAT offers limited cost-effectiveness. In contrast, the advantage of ProQuant becomes much more pronounced in lower-bit settings (e.g., W4A8/W4A4) as demonstrated in Table 1 , making it more suitable for aggressive low-bit quantization where performance preservation is substantially more challenging.
blocks.zh: 在相对温和的W8A8环境下,PTQ方式和ProQuant在所有三个骨干实现与BF16相仿的性能,表明强有力的PTQ方法在这一制度中已经足够了,而QAT的额外培训成本提供了有限的成本效益. 相形之下,ProQuant的优势在下位设置(如W4A8/W4A4)中变得更加明显,如表1所显示的那样,使得它更适合在性能保存难度大得多的地方进行积极的下位分数化.

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Compatibility on weight-only quantization.
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 仅重量化的相容性。

blocks.en: Results in Table 3 show that ProQuant generalizes well beyond W/A quantization and remains effective in weight-only (group-wise) quantization settings. Specifically, under both W4g128 and the more aggressive W3g128 configurations, ProQuant consistently outperforms the PTQ baseline on all benchmarks and yields clear gains in both average accuracy and MME. The advantage is particularly significant at W3g128, where MBQ suffers severe degradation while ProQuant still preserves strong MM performance, demonstrating the robustness and generalizability of our method to low-bit weight-only quantization.
blocks.zh: 表3的结果显示,ProQuant概括远超出W/A的量化,在只重(按组)的量化设置中依然有效. 具体地说,在W4g128和更为积极的W3g128配置下,ProQuant公司在所有基准上一贯超过PTQ基线,并在平均准确度和MME方面都取得了明显的收益。 这一优势在W3g128特别显著,MBQ严重退化,而ProQuant仍然保持了强MM性能,表明我们的方法对于低位重量唯量化的强性和可概括性.

blocks.en: 4.2.4 Scale to large models.
blocks.zh: 4.2.4 (中文(简体) ). 缩放到大型模型。

blocks.en: Table 4 : W/A quantization results on Qwen3-VL- 8B -Instruct .
blocks.zh: 表4: Quen3-VL-8B-指令的W/A定量结果。

blocks.en: Results on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct in Table 4 show that ProQuant generalizes well beyond the small-sized models targeted in our main experiments. It remains highly effective on this large backbone, consistently outperforming the PTQ baseline under both W4A8 and W4A4 quantization. In particular, ProQuant preserves near-full-precision performance at W4A8 and maintains strong MM capability even under the aggressive W4A4 setting, while MBQ collapses. These results demonstrate the strong scalability and generalization ability of ProQuant across model sizes.
blocks.zh: 表4中的Quen3-VL-8B-指令的结果表明,ProQuant的概括远远超出了我们主要实验所针对的小型模型. 它在这种大型骨干上仍然非常有效,在W4A8和W4A4的量化下一直比PTQ基线高。 尤其是ProQuant在W4A8上保留了近乎全精度的性能,即使在侵略性的W4A4设置下也保持了强大的MM能力,而MBQ倒闭. 这些结果表明ProQuant在模型大小上具有强大的可扩展性和通化能力.

blocks.en: 4.2.5 Mixed-precision quantization.
blocks.zh: 4.2.5 混合精度量化。

blocks.en: As pointed out in QAT scaling law [ Chen et al., 2025b ] , persistent outliers in down_proj activations are a major bottleneck for low-bit QAT. Consistent with this observation, our mixed-precision results in Table 5 show that keeping down_proj activations at 8-bit (W4A4 † ) consistently improves performance over full W4A4 quantization.
blocks.zh: 正如QAT缩放定律[Chen等,2025b]所指出,下-proj活化中的持续出值是低位QAT的一个主要瓶颈. 与这一观察一致的是,我们在表5中的混合精度结果显示,在8-位(W4A4 †)时将-proj活化(proj活化)保持下,持续改善性能,而不是完全W4A4量化.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Mixed-precision quantization results on three backbones. The superscript † {\dagger} denotes the W4A4 † setting, where down_proj activations are kept at 8-bit.
blocks.zh: 表5:三根骨干上混合精度量化结果. 上标\\ \ dagger} 表示 W4A4\ 设置, 其中下- proj活化值保持为 8- 位 。

blocks.en: However, the gain varies substantially across backbones ( e.g. , +1.44, +9.39, and +3.21 Avg. points), suggesting that the benefit of mixed-precision design is relatively model-dependent. Therefore, mixed-precision quantization likely requires a more fine-grained, backbone-aware treatment. Here we provide only preliminary evidence and leave a systematic analysis to future work.
blocks.zh: 然而,各骨干部门的收益差别很大(例如:+1.44,+9.39和+3.21 Avg.分),表明混合精度设计的好处相对依赖模型. 因此,混合精度量化可能需要一种更精细、更能认识骨干的待遇。 在此,我们只提供初步证据,并将系统分析留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Step-by-step ablation analysis.
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 分步分析。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : The step-by-step ablation studies on SRL and PBA.
blocks.zh: 图7:关于SRL和PBA的分步发展研究.

blocks.en: We conduct step-by-step ablation studies on Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct under W4A8 and W4A4 settings in Figure 7 . Starting from the naive QAT baseline, the proposed SRL scheme improves the average accuracy by +1.00 and +3.36 under W4A8 and W4A4, respectively, indicating that refined supervision alone already provides meaningful gains. Applying PBA to the same baseline yields gains of +0.67 and +3.02, confirming that the staged quantization strategy also contributes independently by better preserving visual-sensitive layers. Combining both components further increases the average accuracy by +1.44 and +6.07, respectively, achieving the best performance in both settings and demonstrating that SRL and PBA are complementary.
blocks.zh: 在图7中,我们对W4A8和W4A4设置下的Quen3-VL-2B-指示进行分步推进研究。 从天真的QAT基线开始,拟议的SRL方案在W4A8和W4A4下分别将平均准确度提高+1.00和+3.36,表明仅精细监管就已经提供了有意义的收益. 将PBA应用到相同的基线中,得分为+0.67和+3.02,证实所分级的量化策略也通过更好地保存视觉敏感地层而独立地做出贡献. 将这两个组件合并后,平均精度分别提高+1.44和+6.07,实现了两种设置中的最佳性能,并表明SRL和PBA是互补的.

blocks.en: 4.3.3 Ablation on PBA scheduler.
blocks.zh: 4.3.3 PBA排程器上的故障.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 7 , we test the PBA scheduler across 3 different annealing functions, which are Cosine , Linear , and Logarithm , respectively. Taking Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct with 28 decoding layers as an example, we employ the Logarithm functionalized scheduler, which activates 50%, 75%, 88%, and 100% layers as training progresses. Training iterations within each stage are empirically set to ∼ \sim 10% of total iterations, with the remaining budgets assigned to warmup and post-hoc recovery. Our ablation study demonstrates that Logarithm scheduler, which activates more blocks at early stages, yields better performance than Cosine and Linear functions.

We explore how the block splitting strategy affects performance. Table 7 shows that treating each decoding layer as a single activation unit ( 1 × θ DecLayer 1\times\theta_{\text{DecLayer}} ) yields the best accuracy. 0.5 × θ DecLayer 0.5\times\theta_{\text{DecLayer}} treats the attn and ffn modules as separate units, which can trigger asynchronous quantization activation within the same layer and thus hurts performance. 2 × θ DecLayer 2\times\theta_{\text{DecLayer}} leads to severe degradation, suggesting that overly coarse granularity has detrimental side effects.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we present ProQuant , a weight-activation QAT framework tailored for low-bit quantization of small-scale MLLMs.
To mitigate data mismatch under limited fine-tuning budgets, we introduced an SRL scheme that re-annotates open-source MM datasets using the target model, yielding supervision that more closely aligns with the model’s distribution. To address the coupled degradation of MM understanding and language modeling, we proposed a PBA mechanism that prioritizes recovering MM understanding first, guided by a vision-sensitivity factor τ → \vec{\tau} for identifying MM-critical layers. Extensive evaluations on diverse MM benchmarks and models demonstrate that ProQuant achieves near-lossless accuracy under W4A8 and remains robust where PTQ methods collapse at W4A4. We expect ProQuant to facilitate hardware-friendly deployment of MLLMs on resource-constrained edge platforms.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了ProQuant,一个为小型MLLMs低位量化而定制的重量活性QAT框架.
为了减少有限微调预算下的数据不匹配,我们引入了一个SRL计划,利用目标模型重新注释开源的MM数据集,产生与模型分布更紧密相匹配的监督. 为了解决MM理解和语言模型的退化问题,我们建议了一种PBA机制,该机制以视觉敏化系数\\vec\tau}为指导,优先恢复MM理解,以识别MM关键层。 对多种MM基准和模型的广泛评价表明,ProQuant公司在W4A8下实现了近乎无损的准确性,并且在W4A4的PTQ方法倒闭时仍然很强. 我们期望ProQuant公司为在受资源限制的边缘平台上部署MLLM提供硬件便利。

blocks.en: A.1 Background
blocks.zh: A.1 背景情况

blocks.en:
Existing QAT solutions primarily focus on low-bit weight-only quantization [ Chen et al., 2025a ; Du et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2024a ; Guo et al., 2025 ] .
However, weight-only inference typically relies on floating-point cores to process activations, incurring substantial power and area overhead on edge AI chips [ Van Baalen et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024b ] .
This practical constraint motivates us to pursue high-performance weight-activation quantization, and our work targets weight-activation QAT for low-bit edge MLLMs.
blocks.zh:
现有的QAT解决方案主要侧重于低位重量只量化[Chen等,2025a;Du等,2024;Huang等,2024a;Guo等,2025].
然而,只有重量的推论一般依靠浮点核来处理活化,在边缘AI芯片上产生相当的功率和面积上浮出水面[Van Baalen等,2023;Li等,2024b].
这个实际的制约促使我们追求高性能的重量活化量子化,我们的工作目标是为低位边缘的MLLM进行重量活化QAT.

blocks.en:
SmoothQuant-style methods [ Xiao et al., 2023 ] achieve strong accuracy at W8A8, but pushing to lower-bit settings often depends on rotation-based quantization [ Ashkboos et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2024 ] .
Although the overhead can be modest on GPUs [ Ashkboos et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2024 ] , such online rotations typically require additional hardware support on edge chips, increasing chip area and compute cost [ Kim et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2026 ] .
In contrast, ProQuant introduces no extra runtime operators during inference beyond standard quantized linear layers.

虽然对GPU的间接费用可能不大[Ashkboos等人, 2024; Sun等, 2024]),这种在线自转通常需要在边缘芯片上得到额外的硬件支持,增加芯片面积并计算成本[Kim等. 2026;刘等,2026;董等,2026].
相形之下,ProQuant在推论期间没有引入超出标准量线性地层的额外运行时间运算符.

blocks.en: A.3 Training-based Quantization

blocks.en:
Training-based quantization introduces learnable parameters [ Xie et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024b ] or functions [ Nagel et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2021 ] to recover quantized model accuracy in a block-wise [ Li et al., 2021 ; Shao et al., 2023 ] or network-wise manner [ Liu et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ] .
In this paper, ProQuant performs network-level QAT by learning the quantization scales s s together with the weight parameters 𝐖 \mathbf{W} .
To make the rounding operator ⌊ ⋅ ⌉ \lfloor\cdot\rceil differentiable, we adopt the straight-through estimator (STE) [ Bengio et al., 2013 ] .
Following prior works [ Liu et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026a ] , we employ self-distillation, where the full-precision model serves as the teacher to guide the quantized student.
We also incorporate supervision from the training response labels, as in [ Guo et al., 2025 ] .
Specifically, our objective is a weighted sum of forward KL, reverse KL, and cross-entropy losses: ℒ QAT = α ℒ KL ( P s | | P t ) + ( 1 − α ) ℒ KL ( P t | | P s ) + β ℒ CE ( Y , P s ) , \mathcal{L}_{\text{QAT}}=\alpha\mathcal{L}_{\text{KL}}(P_{s}||P_{t})+(1-\alpha)\mathcal{L}_{\text{KL}}(P_{t}||P_{s})+\beta\mathcal{L}_{\text{CE}}(Y,P_{s}), (A2) where α \alpha is estimated at the start of training as the average token probability over a randomly sampled mini-batch [ Guo et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2024 ] .
We empirically set β \beta to match the scale of the other loss terms.
Here, P t P_{t} and P s P_{s} are teacher and student token-probability distributions obtained by applying softmax to their logits. For ProQuant , Y = Y SRL Y=Y_{\mathrm{SRL}} denotes the self-relabeled response targets; labeler ablations replace these targets with the corresponding label set. More discussion is provided in Appendix D.2 .

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 outlines the training procedure of ProQuant . Starting from the re-labeled dataset 𝒟 SRL \mathcal{D}_{\text{SRL}} , the full-precision teacher ℳ FP \mathcal{M}_{\text{FP}} , and the quantized student ℳ Q \mathcal{M}_{\text{Q}} , the model is optimized over S S steps with a predefined activation schedule 𝕋 \mathbb{T} and block budget 𝔹 \mathbb{B} . At scheduled steps, ProQuant performs teacher-student forward propagation, computes the QAT loss, updates the quantized parameters, and progressively activates more quantized blocks based on the estimated sensitivity. At all other steps, the student model is updated with standard QAT.

blocks.en: We present one full example from the COCO caption dataset [ Liu et al., 2024a ] in Figure A1 . It is evident that the two responses exhibit distinct stylistic characteristics, suggesting a potential distribution gap between them. Specifically, GPT-style responses tend to be more literal and spatially grounded, emphasizing object presence and layout with explicit positional phrases such as in the center of the table, closer to the top left corner, and along the top edge. In contrast, Qwen-style responses are more holistic, semantically enriched, and interpretive, focusing more on scene-level summarization, attributes, and visual appeal, as reflected in expressions such as colorful and creatively decorated donuts, different flavors, toppings, and textures, and a delightful and tempting selection of sweet treats. This discrepancy indicates that, even when describing the same image, different caption sources may encode substantially different linguistic preferences and descriptive priors. Such stylistic inconsistency can further introduce additional challenges for model adaptation and alignment, especially when the training objective implicitly assumes a unified target distribution.

blocks.en: C.3 Training Configuration
blocks.zh: C.3 培训配置

blocks.en:
We implement ProQuant in PyTorch and train quantized models with DeepSpeed . Each experiment is conducted on a single 8 × \times H200 node.
Unless otherwise specified, we fine-tune quantized models for 5 epochs in BF16, enabling gradient checkpoints and using gradient accumulation with 2 steps.
We set the per-device batch size to 32 and the maximum sequence length to 8192 tokens.
We use the AdamW optimizer with a constant learning rate, zero weight decay, and a maximum gradient norm of 1.0.
During QAT, we freeze the vision transformer and train the remaining modules together with the quantization scales, using module-specific learning rates.
We optimize a hybrid objective that combines forward KL, reverse KL, and supervised fine-tuning losses, as defined in Eq. A2 . The QAT takes ∼ \sim 2 GPU days for 2B-scale models.
blocks.zh:
我们在PyTorch执行ProQuant 并用 DeepSpeed 训练量子模型。 每个实验都是在一个单 8 ×\ times H200节点上进行的.
除非另有说明,否则我们将对BF16中5个纪元的量化模型进行微调,以便建立梯度检查点,并使用梯度累积2个步骤。
我们规定每台设备的批量尺寸为32个,最大序列长度为8192个令牌.
我们使用 AdamW 优化器 恒定学习速率,零重量衰减,最大梯度规范为1.0.
在QAT期间,我们使用模块特定学习率冻结了视觉变压器,并结合量化尺度来培训其余模块.
按照Eq.A2的定义,我们优化了混合目标,将前向KL、倒向KL以及监督微调损失结合起来。 2B级模型的QAT需要 \ sim 2 GPU 日 。

blocks.en: D.2 Ablation Study on Loss Functions
blocks.zh: D.2 损失函数分析研究

blocks.en:
We present performance under different supervision objectives for W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct QAT in Table A2 .
Using a single KL term yields limited gains, where forward KL achieves 71.76% on average accuracy while reversed KL performs worse, suggesting that either direction alone provides insufficient guidance for stable recovery. Combining both terms via CAKLD [ Du et al., 2024 ] improves the average accuracy to 71.94%, indicating that balancing the two divergences is beneficial. The balance factor α \alpha is estimated at the start of training as described above.
Building on CAKLD, our multi-objective formulation further incorporates a cross-entropy term following [ Guo et al., 2025 ] , achieving the best performance. Overall, the results validate that jointly leveraging bidirectional distillation and label supervision provides the most effective training signal for low-bit QAT.

我们在表A2的不同监督下介绍了W4A8 Qune3-VL-2B-指示QAT的业绩。
使用单一的KL术语产生的收益有限,即远期KL平均准确度达到71.76%,而反向KL表现更差,这表明,单靠两个方向都不足以指导稳定的恢复。 通过CAKLD[Du等,2024年]合并这两个术语,将平均准确度提高到71.94%,表明平衡这两个差异是有益的. 如上所述,在开始培训时估计了余额系数α-α。
在CAKLD的基础上,我们的多目标表述进一步包含了[Guo等,2025年]之后的交叉性术语,实现了最佳业绩. 总体而言,结果证实,联合利用双向蒸馏和标签监督为低位QAT提供了最有效的培训信号.

blocks.en: Response style is a component of the output distribution, rather than an alternative to distributional alignment. Vocabulary, length, and format characterize surface form, while embedding similarity characterizes semantics; these diagnostics are complementary views and are not an additive decomposition of NLL. Matching surface form alone does not explain the full gain: the same-family 8B labeler reaches reference vocabulary coverage (1.000), but its NLL remains 0.906 versus 0.474 for self-labels and its QAT accuracy remains lower.

blocks.en: At W4A4, the NLL ranking agrees exactly with the inverse accuracy ranking. At W4A8, GPT versus LV-7B is an exception (their NLL differs by 0.009). Moreover, LV-0.5B is closer to the reference than LV-7B on all four auxiliary diagnostics, but has higher NLL and lower QAT accuracy at both precisions. These results support target-distribution proximity as an explanation of SRL’s gain beyond a single stylistic property.

blocks.en: E.1 Hardware Architecture
blocks.zh: E.1 硬件结构

blocks.en: We evaluate an edge MLLM accelerator using measured test-chip behavior and a cycle-accurate accelerator model, as detailed in Section E.2 . Figure A2 shows its architecture. The accelerator is equipped with two Mixed-Precision Tensor Engines (MPTEs), each of which comprises 1K MACs organized into 32 PE lines under an output-stationary dataflow, delivering 2.46 TOPS at INT8 precision. The MPTEs are able to support BF16, INT8 and INT4 precision for both weights and activations. Besides, two Special Processing Units (SPUs) support BF16 softmax, normalization, and dynamic quantization. Furthermore, output feature map tiles from the MPTEs can be bypassed directly to the SPU’s local token buffer to facilitate layer fusion, effectively overlapping the dynamic quantization latency. Two Auxiliary Engines handle element-wise operations, such as RoPE, and various data movement tasks like reshaping and transposing. The accelerator also features a 4 MB global token buffer and a 4 MB weight buffer, connected via a DDR4 interface that delivers 38.4 GB/s of external memory bandwidth. The compute engines and on-chip buffers are interconnected via a network-on-chip (NoC).
blocks.zh: 如E.2节所详述,我们利用测量到的试验芯片行为和循环精确加速器模型来评估边缘MLLM加速器。 图A2显示了它的架构. 加速器装有两台混合精密十进制发动机(MPTE),每台发动机由1KMAC组成,在输出-固定数据流下被组织为32个PE线,以INT8精密方式提供2.46个TOPS. MPTE能够支持BF16,INT8和INT4的精度来进行重量和活化. 此外,两个特别处理股(SPU)支持BF16软max,正态化,并动态地量化. 此外,MPTEs的输出特性图片可以被直接绕到SPU的本地符号缓冲器来方便地层聚变,有效地重叠了能动的量子化空位. 两个辅助引擎处理元素取向操作,如ROPE,以及重塑和移植等各种数据移动任务. 加速器还具有4MB全局符号缓冲器和4MB重量缓冲器,通过DDR4接口连接,可提供38.4GB/s的外置内存带宽. 计算引擎和芯片缓冲器通过网接芯片(NoC)相接.

blocks.en: E.3 Edge Evaluation Results
blocks.zh: E.3 边际评价结果

blocks.en: Tables A7 , A8 , and A9 present comprehensive latency and energy measurements for Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct , Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct and Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct on the edge MLLM accelerator. Across all three models, the prefill stage shows W4A8 achieving 1.48 ∼ \sim 1.89 × \times speedup and 1.94 ∼ \sim 3.13 × \times energy savings, while W4A4 further attains 2.11 ∼ \sim 3.64 × \times speedup and 2.53 ∼ \sim 5.64 × \times energy reduction. The decode stage exhibits consistent 3.74 ∼ \sim 3.98 × \times speedup and 3.76 ∼ \sim 3.99 × \times energy savings for both W4A8 and W4A4 due to memory-bound issue. Notably, the speedup ratio diminishes with longer visual token length since the ViT FLOPs proportion increases. As the ViT backbone typically remains in BF16 precision to preserve visual features, it becomes a bottleneck on edge accelerators where BF16 compute resources are insufficient due to area constraints. These results validate that ProQuant generalizes effectively across model scales and delivers substantial efficiency gains for edge deployment.

blocks.en: Moving from W8A8 to W4A8 halves weight traffic and primarily improves memory-bound decode. Moving from W4A8 to W4A4 additionally lowers activation precision and benefits prefill. Relative to W8A8, the supported W4A8 and W4A4 configurations offer approximately 2 × 2\times and 4 × 4\times peak compute throughput, respectively; these hardware peak ratios are not end-to-end measured speedups. Off-chip data movement can be energy-intensive, motivating the reduction in weight traffic.

blocks.en: Our experiments focus on compact MLLMs, with evaluated models up to 8B parameters. Extending ProQuant to larger models and a broader range of multimodal architectures remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验侧重于紧凑的 MLLMs, 被评价的模型可达8B参数. 将ProQuant扩展至更大的模型和范围更广的多式联运结构仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en:
By reducing inference memory requirements, latency, and energy consumption in the evaluated deployment setting, ProQuant can facilitate multimodal intelligence on resource-constrained devices. More efficient local inference may broaden access to multimodal applications and reduce reliance on remote
computing infrastructure.
blocks.zh:
ProQuant公司通过减少评价部署环境中的推断内存要求、耐久性和能耗,可以促进关于资源受限装置的多式情报。 更有效的本地推论可以扩大对多式联运应用的利用,并减少对远程技术的依赖。
